description: KNaTe(HO)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P31c space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three equivalent H and six O atoms. All K-H bond lengths are 2.86 Å. There are three shorter (2.91 Å) and three longer (3.14 Å) K-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.43 Å) and three longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) H-O bond length. Te is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Te-O bond lengths are 1.89 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, two H, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one K, one Na, and two H atoms.
